voices.tooltip.add_to_render_queue_a1747: Queue the dialogue for voice generation using the selected voice, language, and direction.
voices.tooltip.aiden_93cddc: Sunny American English-speaking male voice with a clear midrange.
voices.tooltip.auto_126bef: Let the model identify the language from your dialogue.
voices.tooltip.cancel_35afca: Stop the current recording or transcription and discard its unfinished text.
voices.tooltip.choose_audio_file_1ef8ba: Select an audio file up to two minutes and 25 MiB to transcribe.
voices.tooltip.clone_a_voice_9fc9cc: Copy the voice in a short reference clip (3 to 30 seconds) and speak new text in it. Needs the Base checkpoint (tts-base) and the clip’s exact transcript.
voices.tooltip.copy_text_6426ce: Copy the completed transcript to your clipboard.
voices.tooltip.design_a_voice_d399f5: Create a new voice from a written description, then speak your text in it. Needs the VoiceDesign checkpoint (tts-voicedesign).
voices.tooltip.dylan_495598: Youthful male voice with a Beijing accent. Native language: Chinese.
voices.tooltip.eric_a88d02: Lively male voice with a Sichuan accent. Native language: Chinese.
voices.tooltip.fine_detail_sampling_0fe1: Switches sampling on or off for the second-stage model that fills in each frame’s fine acoustic detail. Greedy is repeatable but flatter.
voices.tooltip.fine_detail_temperature_9: Randomness of the fine-detail stage, 0.05 to 2. The model default is 0.9; lower is cleaner, higher adds texture.
voices.tooltip.fine_detail_top_k_5b77b8: Limits the fine-detail stage to the k likeliest choices (1 to 1000). The model default is 50.
voices.tooltip.fine_detail_top_p_6277c3: Nucleus sampling for the fine-detail stage, above 0 up to 1. The model default is 1.
voices.tooltip.fine_tune_voice_3ab400: Optional speech length, variation (temperature, top-p, top-k, repetition penalty) and seed controls.
voices.tooltip.language_9a73db: Choose the language for the spoken text. Auto lets the model identify it.
voices.tooltip.live_speech_to_text_f9489: Transcribe speech from your microphone or an audio file with the local English speech recognition model.
voices.tooltip.only_clone_voices_you_hav: Confirm that you have permission to use this person’s voice. Forge requires this before queuing a clone.
voices.tooltip.ono_anna_32ddf2: Playful female voice with a light, nimble timbre. Native language: Japanese.
voices.tooltip.preset_voice_24205c: Speak with one of the nine built-in speakers, with optional voice direction. Uses the CustomVoice checkpoint, which is installed with the speech worker.
voices.tooltip.project_7b5fea: Choose where the generated voice file will be saved.
voices.tooltip.recognition_options_2a95a: Choose punctuation, word timing and latency for the speech recognizer.
voices.tooltip.reference_transcript_opti: Not needed for a voice-only clone, which ignores this text. Otherwise it is the exact words spoken in the reference clip. Up to 1,000 characters.
voices.tooltip.reference_transcript_requ: The exact words spoken in the reference clip. Cloning uses the transcript with the audio to match the voice, so a wrong or partial transcript lowers the match. Up to 1,000 characters.
voices.tooltip.ryan_c2af04: Dynamic, rhythmic English-speaking male voice. Best for English dialogue.
voices.tooltip.sampling_mode_89d898: Sample gives varied takes; Greedy always picks the likeliest speech token, so temperature, top-p and top-k have no effect. Blank uses the model default (sampling).
voices.tooltip.serena_1046a6: Warm, gentle young female voice. Native language: Chinese.
voices.tooltip.sohee_0cb6fc: Warm female voice with rich emotion. Native language: Korean.
voices.tooltip.speech_token_limit_a029f5: Set the maximum tokens used to generate speech, from 64 to 4,096 (about 12.5 tokens per second). Speech that reaches the limit stops mid-sentence.
voices.tooltip.start_microphone_364764: Ask for microphone access and transcribe your speech live. Recording begins only after access is granted.
voices.tooltip.stop_finish_6ea773: Stop recording and wait for the final transcript to appear.
voices.tooltip.uncle_fu_d0b6dd: Seasoned male voice with a low, mellow timbre. Native language: Chinese.
voices.tooltip.use_as_voice_text_f1ab2d: Put the transcript into the voice dialogue field. Voice renders accept up to 1,000 characters.
voices.tooltip.vivian_d207f1: Bright, slightly edgy young female voice. Native language: Chinese.
voices.tooltip.voice_27d1a4: Choose one of nine preset speakers. Each can speak every language, but sounds best in its native one. Preset voices use the CustomVoice checkpoint; cloning and design use their own checkpoints.
voices.tooltip.voice_description_7946a7: Describe the voice in up to 500 characters: age, gender, tone, accent, pace and emotion. Each render with the same description and seed repeats; without a seed, the voice can vary.
voices.tooltip.voice_direction_04556d: Add optional guidance for the delivery, such as tone, pace, or personality.
voices.tooltip.voice_only_no_transcript_: Copy the voice from the clip alone, without a transcript. Forge does not send the transcript, so you do not need to type it. The result usually sounds less like the speaker than a transcript-matched clone.
voices.tooltip.what_should_your_characte: Enter the dialogue to turn into speech. The selected voice and language shape the finished audio.
